'''Nallera's Mining Station''' , also known as the '''Tatooine Mining Outpost''', was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Nallera's Mining Field]], in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />
